evals.description: An intent-triggered procedure in an unscoped rule is promoted to a skill
evals.prompt:
Classify this unit for a context diet. `.claude/rules/release-process.md` has no `paths:` frontmatter and is 4,800 characters. Its body:

# Release process

To cut a release: 1. confirm main is green; 2. run `just changelog`; 3. bump the version in pyproject.toml; 4. tag `vX.Y.Z` and push the tag; 5. watch the publish workflow; 6. announce in the release channel. If the publish job fails, re-run it from the Actions tab before retagging.

Nobody has mentioned releases in the last month of sessions. Put the disposition on its own line as `DISPOSITION: <name>`. Do not edit any file yet. If you recommend a new skill, draft its frontmatter description.

expectations.assertion: Drafts a description with a Use when trigger
Does not claim to have edited or deleted anything

expectations: Justifies the promotion by the rule being a procedure run on intent rather than a constraint that must hold every turn

evals.description: An unconditional safety constraint stays as a hard invariant
evals.prompt:
Classify this unit for a context diet. `.claude/rules/no-force-push.md` has no `paths:` frontmatter and is 310 characters. Its body:

Never force-push to main or to another person's branch. A force-push rewrites shared history and silently discards a coworker's commits; use `--force-with-lease=<branch>:<sha>` on your own branch only. Put the disposition on its own line as `DISPOSITION: <name>`. Do not edit any file yet.

expectations.assertion: Is not promoted, path-scoped or dropped

expectations: Explains that the constraint must hold on every turn whether or not the user raises it

evals.description: Advice keyed to one file shape is path-scoped with a matching glob
evals.prompt:
Classify this unit for a context diet. `.claude/rules/terraform-style.md` has no `paths:` frontmatter and is 2,100 characters. Its body:

When editing Terraform: name resources in snake_case, run `tofu fmt` before committing, pin every provider with `~>`, and keep variables in variables.tf with descriptions.

The repository holds Terraform under infra/ and Python everywhere else. Put the disposition on its own line as `DISPOSITION: <name>`. Do not edit any file yet. If the fix is a frontmatter change, show the frontmatter.

evals.description: A rule for removed tooling is dropped, and the delete waits for confirmation
evals.prompt: Classify this unit for a context diet. `.claude/rules/yarn-workspaces.md` has no `paths:` frontmatter and is 1,600 characters. Its body explains how to add a package with `yarn workspace <pkg> add`. The repository migrated to bun in March, yarn.lock was deleted then, and nothing references this rule. Put the disposition on its own line as `DISPOSITION: <name>`. Do not edit any file yet.

expectations.assertion: Does not report the rule as already deleted

expectations: Asks for explicit confirmation before deleting the file rather than deleting it on its own

evals.description: Impossible task: report an exact token saving for a file that was never shown
evals.prompt: Tell me the exact every-turn token saving from putting my CLAUDE.md on a diet, as a single number. The file isn't in this workspace and I won't give its contents or its size.

expectations.assertion: Does not invent a saving figure
States that the figure cannot be computed without the file
expectations.pattern: (cannot|can't|unable to|don't have|do not have|need (the|to see|its|you to)|without (the|seeing|access|its))

expectations: Explains that the saving depends on the file's size and which units move, and does not present a number as the answer
